answer.en: Yes, dogs can eat mango in moderation, as long as it is properly prepared: peel it and remove the pit. Mango is high in sugar, so keep it an occasional treat, especially for dogs who struggle with their weight.
answer.sl: Da, psi lahko zmerno jedo mango, če je pravilno pripravljen: olupite ga in odstranite koščico. Mango vsebuje veliko sladkorja, zato naj ostane občasen priboljšek, zlasti za pse, ki imajo težave s težo.

why.en: Mango contains fibre and vitamins A, B6, C and E. The pit is a serious choking hazard, can get stuck in the digestive tract and contains small amounts of cyanide. The skin is hard to digest. Too much fruit can cause bellyache and diarrhoea.
why.sl: Mango vsebuje vlaknine ter vitamine A, B6, C in E. Koščica je resna nevarnost, da se pes zaduši, lahko se zagozdi v prebavilih in vsebuje majhne količine cianida. Lupina je težko prebavljiva. Preveč sadja lahko povzroči bolečine v trebuhu in drisko.

what_to_do.en: If you have questions or concerns about feeding your dog mango, ask your vet.
what_to_do.sl: Če imate vprašanja ali pomisleke glede dajanja manga psu, se posvetujte z veterinarjem.

serving.en: Peeled, with the pit removed, cut into small pieces; as an occasional treat.
serving.sl: Olupljen, brez koščice, narezan na majhne koščke; kot občasen priboljšek.

child.en: Dogs can taste a little mango! A grown-up peels it and takes out the big stone first.
child.sl: Psi lahko poskusijo malo manga! Odrasel ga najprej olupi in odstrani veliko koščico.

q.en: Why must the mango pit be removed?
q.sl: Zakaj je treba odstraniti koščico manga?

a.en: The pit can make a dog choke or get stuck in its digestive tract, and it contains small amounts of cyanide.
a.sl: Pes se lahko s koščico zaduši ali se mu ta zagozdi v prebavilih, poleg tega vsebuje majhne količine cianida.

q.sl: Ali lahko psi jedo lupino manga?

a.en: It is difficult to digest, so it is best to remove it before serving.
a.sl: Težko je prebavljiva, zato jo je najbolje odstraniti pred serviranjem.

sources.quote: The answer is yes, they can.
This fruit is full of vitamins and safe for your dog to consume, as long as it's properly prepared.
Mango is high in fiber, as well as vitamins A, B6, C, and E, making it quite nutritious for both humans and dogs.
It's important to note that you should only give your dog mango in moderation.
Too much of any fruit or vegetable can cause bellyaches and diarrhea.
Mango pits, on the other hand, can be a serious choking hazard and get stuck in your dog's digestive tract.
The pit of a mango also contains small amounts of cyanide.
While dogs can technically eat the skin, it's difficult to digest, so it's best to remove it beforehand.
Always remove the skin and pit, and cut the fruit into small pieces to prevent choking and digestion issues.
If you have questions or concerns about feeding your dog mango, consult a veterinarian.
Mango is high in sugar, so use it as an occasional treat, especially for dogs who struggle with weight.
Mango – remove hard stone/pit and skin
